```{r}
# libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(table1)
library(reshape2)
```

```{r}
df = read.csv("../Data/240508_metadata_prepped.csv")
df = df[df$time==1, ]
df$is_patient = as.factor(df$is_patient)
df = df[df$time == 1, ] #& !is.na(df$pain_avg)

T1 = table1(
  ~ gender + 
    age + 
    weight + 
    ethnicity + 
    backpain_length +
    pain_avg_t1 + 
    n_spike_regs_sponpain +
    promis_dep_t1 + 
    promis_anger_t1 + 
    promis_anxiety_t1 + 
    negative_affect_t1 +
    promis_sleep_t1 +
    bpi_intensity_t1 +
    bpi_interference_t1 + 
    odi_t1| is_patient, data=df,
       render.continuous=c( .="Median [Min, Max]"))
```


```{r}
df = read.csv("../Data/240508_metadata_prepped.csv")
df = df[df$time == 1, ]
df[df$is_patient == 0, ]$backpain_length = 0

cols = c("motion_outliers", "n_spike_regs_sponpain", "promis_sleep_t1", "negative_affect_t1", "odi_t1", 
         "bpi_intensity_t1", "backpain_length", "ethnicity", "weight",  "age", "gender", "is_patient")

df_num = na.omit(df[cols])  # remove Nan & subset interesting cols
df_num <- apply(df_num, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))

cormat <- round(cor(df_num),2) # get correlations
melted_cormat <- melt(cormat, na.rm = TRUE)

gg_heat <- ggplot(data = melted_cormat, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
    midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1,1), 
    space = "Lab",
    name="Pearson\nCorrelation") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, size = 12, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_fixed() + 
geom_text(aes(Var2, Var1, label = value), color = "black", size = 4)
```

```{r}
df_melt <- melt(df[cols], na.rm = TRUE, id.vars = "is_patient")
df_melt$is_patient[df_melt$is_patient == 0] <- "HC"
df_melt$is_patient[df_melt$is_patient == 1] <- "CBP"
df_melt$is_patient <- factor(df_melt$is_patient, levels=c("HC", "CBP"))


vars_basic = c("age", "weight")
vars_pain = c("pain_avg_t1", "odi_t1", "bpi_intensity_t1", "bpi_interference_t1")
vars_promis = c("promis_anxiety_t1", "promis_dep_t1", "promis_anger_t1", "negative_affect_t1", "promis_sleep_t1")
```
